concerns.text: T022b (Global Covariance) depends on T012 (raw_data.parquet), but T024 (Filtering) also depends on T012. The notes state 'T022b MUST run BEFORE T024', yet T022b reads 'entire aligned dataset before filtering'. If T024 runs first (as implied by T025a-core depending on T024), T022b will read filtered data or fail. The dependency graph must explicitly enforce T022b -> T024 to ensure global stats are computed on the unfiltered set as required by FR-002.

T025a-core depends on T024 (filtered data) and T022a (per-sample stats). However, T022a depends on T012. If T024 filters out samples, T025a-core must ensure it only computes features for the *remaining* samples. The task description says 'Read aligned data from... raw_data.parquet (full dataset) and the filtered dataset', which is ambiguous. It must explicitly state: 'Compute per-sample stats ONLY for samples present in the filtered dataset (T024 output)' to avoid computing features on excluded samples.

T022c (Mahalanobis) depends on T027d (Model Selection) and T024 (Filtered Data). However, T027d depends on T025a-core. This creates a cycle: T022c -> T027d -> T025a-core -> T022c (via T025a-core depending on T022a which is independent, but T025b depends on T022c). The dependency chain for Mahalanobis is circular if T025a-core is required before T027d, but T022c (which feeds T025b) requires T027d. The graph must be linearized: T022c should run after T027d, and T025b (which merges Mahalanobis) must run after T022c. T025a-core should NOT depend on T022c.

T027d (Model Selection) depends on T025a-core. T025a-core computes base features. However, T027d determines if Mahalanobis (T022c) is needed. T022c depends on T027d. This is correct. BUT, T027d also depends on T038 (Schema Validation). T038 depends on T037/T037b. T037/T037b are in Phase 2. T027d is in Phase 5. The ordering is correct, but the dependency on T025a-core is risky if T025a-core is heavy. The plan states T027d runs 'after T025a-core to have base features', but T027d only needs N (count) and model_type logic. It should depend on T024 (which provides N) directly, not the full feature computation of T025a-core, to avoid unnecessary blocking.

T000 creates research.md with a 'Verified datasets' block. T037 depends on T000. T037 performs the actual download/verification. The order is correct (definition before use), but T000 is marked [P] (parallel). Since T037 depends on it, T000 must complete before T037 starts. The [P] tag is misleading if it implies it can run concurrently with T037. It should be untagged or the dependency graph must ensure T000 finishes before T037 begins.
